properties.info: A simplified map of Obotrite lands in present-day Mecklenburg around 1000. The Obotrites were a West Slavic tribal confederation with their own princes and regional centers of power, not a centralized realm with borders matching modern Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. After the revolt of 983, the area was no longer under lasting Ottonian control; the modern region is only a rough map reference.
